description.value: A large commercial RV resort on the Chemainus River amid old-growth forest, with 54 dedicated tent sites alongside 130+ RV sites; the heated pool, mini-golf, and four playgrounds suit families well, though the resort atmosphere is decidedly RV-park in character.

address.value: 9010 Trans Canada Hwy, Chemainus, BC V0R 1K4

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content is comprehensive and confirms the resort is open year-round with 54 tenting sites (corroborating OSM tents=yes), laundry facilities, a seasonal general store, and online reservations. The phone number matches OSM exactly, but the postal code differs consistently across multiple website pages (V0R 1K4) versus OSM (V0R 1K0), so the website value is used and the discrepancy flagged. No explicit mention of hiker/biker-specific sites, showers, device charging, or other amenities not listed, so those remain null.
concerns: Postal code mismatch: OSM records V0R 1K0 but the website consistently shows V0R 1K4 across the front page, About page, and Contact page. The website value (V0R 1K4) has been used as the canonical address.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A year-round campground on the Trans-Canada Highway through Vancouver Island with 54 tenting sites, laundry, and a general store — a practical and well-documented overnight option for touring cyclists on a heavily used cycling corridor.

wow_evidence: 54 dedicated tent sites alongside 130+ RV sites; laundry facilities, a seasonal general store
